_why: Steps held longer in the deck than they ran in the recording, as a factor on every frame. Only for a step that is text on a screen: step 0 is the title card and the seven introductions, about two hundred words, and the run it was recorded in went through them in thirty-two seconds, which is twice as fast as a room reads. Stretching that is not dishonest the way stretching a cluster would be -- nothing happens in it except words appearing. Anything with a pod, a queue or a node in it stays at the speed it really ran. Read by both film.mjs, which does the stretching, and extract.py, which tells the notes how long the slide is.
